visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a hand using a metal spoon to scoop a generous portion of Mapo Tofu, with its glossy red sauce and soft white cubes, onto a bowl of steamed white rice. The background shows a wooden table with other blurred dishes under bright, warm indoor lighting. (2) The camera pans across a dining table covered with various Sichuan dishes in ceramic bowls, including green beans and meat stews, in a well-lit restaurant setting with modern wooden furniture. (3) A close-up focus on a bowl of Mapo Tofu garnished with green onions, showing the steam rising and the vibrant red chili oil, followed by another scoop of the tofu being lifted. (4) Transition to a black stone bowl containing sliced beef in a spicy red broth topped with bean sprouts and chili flakes, with a spoon stirring the meat to show its texture. (5) A white bowl of fish slices cooked with pickled cabbage (Suancai Yu) is shown, with a spoon lifting a portion of fish and translucent vermicelli, highlighting the yellowish-green broth. (6) A plate of dry-fried green beans with minced meat is presented, showing the wrinkled texture of the beans under bright lighting. (7) A close-up of thick, braised pork belly slices (Mao's Braised Pork) dripping with dark savory sauce as it is lifted by a spoon over a small clay pot. (8) Sliced chicken pieces with cucumber and sesame seeds are shown being picked up with chopsticks, coated in a glossy brown sauce. (9) A wooden spoon pours a clear, golden chicken soup into a bowl from a black ceramic pot. (10) A fried golden bun (Mantou) is dipped into a small dish of white condensed milk, showing its crispy exterior and soft yellow interior. (11) A piece of fried sweet potato cake coated in peanut powder is dipped into a dark syrup sauce using chopsticks. (12) Wide shots of the restaurant's interior featuring modern gray walls, wooden tables, and minimalist lighting, followed by the exterior storefront with a large red banner and the restaurant's name sign.

(2) As the visuals transition through various dishes, the narrator maintains a consistent pace, describing the spicy flavor of Mapo Tofu and the tenderness of the beef, with the guitar music providing a bright, positive backdrop. (3) The narration continues seamlessly, highlighting the pickled cabbage fish and green beans, with subtle sounds of liquid pouring heard faintly in the mix during the soup scene. (4) The track concludes with the narrator inviting viewers to visit the restaurant and providing the address, while the upbeat acoustic music swells slightly before fading out at the end of the clip.
